name: megascenes-sticker
description: Create sticker designs with a bold outline on a clean background, ready for die-cut printing or messaging apps.

interface.longDescription:
Describe a subject and a style and get a sticker design: a bold outline on a clean background, ready for die-cut printing, laptops or chat apps.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the sticker in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The sticker opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For small shops, journaling, events and messaging packs.

Limitations: new designs as image files; it does not cut out a photo you attach or print the stickers. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Return the sticker in the chat
defaultPrompt: A happy avocado with sunglasses, cartoon sticker
A retro sticker of a camper van under a sunset
A cute ghost holding a coffee cup, kawaii style

positive.prompt: A happy avocado with sunglasses, cartoon sticker. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one sticker needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A retro sticker of a camper van under a sunset. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one sticker needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a sticker here?
positive.expected_behavior: The sticker models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A cute ghost holding a coffee cup, kawaii style sticker. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my sticker on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my sticker to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
